# @three-ws/ibm-x402-mcp

> x402 pay-per-use MCP server for IBM Granite AI — chat, code, embeddings, analysis, and time-series forecasting. Pay USDC on Solana per call. No IBM Cloud account required.

@three-ws/ibm-x402-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/ibm-x402-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/ibm-x402-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/ibm-x402-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/ibm-x402-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/ibm-x402-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
